title: A full hour, an urgent task
hook: Your hour is fully booked. Where does an urgent 10-minute task go?

knows: reading short labels and comparing simple counts
doesNotKnow: that an unplanned task needs free time that already exists in the plan, so leaving a slot unassigned is what lets the day absorb it

misconception: A fully booked day is the most efficient plan.
objective: Recognise that spare calendar capacity is an explicit resource.

claims.text: Scenario, hook and prediction: Your hour is fully booked. Where does an urgent 10-minute task go? Focus, admin and a call fill minutes 0 to 60. An urgent 10-minute task has to go in after focus. When is everything done? Options: Minute 70 / Minute 60: it's only 10 minutes. Correct option: Minute 70. All fixture labels, example words, dates, task durations and file fields are stipulated exercise data.
